description: This file is the main React component and entry point for a Remix-based frontend application. It defines the app layout, global metadata, and the loader function to fetch current user info for the app shell.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Sets the base metadata for the app, including the title and description.

methods.name: links
methods.description: Provides links to external stylesheets and preconnect hints.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches current user data (if authenticated) for server-side rendering to make user info available globally.

methods.name: Layout
methods.description: Main layout component that renders the page structure, conditional navigation links based on user auth state, and app shell.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Default export that renders the nested route outlet.
